description: This is a JUnit test class for the FilterUtil utility class in the OpenMRS project. It tests storing and restoring user locale functionality.

classes.name: FilterUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing FilterUtil's locale storage and restoration methods.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldStoreLocale
methods.description: Tests that the storeLocale method correctly stores a locale.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldRestoreLocale
methods.description: Tests that restoreLocale retrieves the previously stored locale.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldNotChangeStoredValueWhenStoringSameLocale
methods.description: Checks that storing the same locale multiple times does not alter the stored value.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldNotUpdateStoredValueWhenStoringDifferentLocale
methods.description: Verifies that when a different locale is stored, the stored value is updated accordingly.
